chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله forbade stepping over the camel line.
It was said, "O Messenger of Allah, and why?" He said, "Because there is no camel line except that between one camel and the next there is a devil."

key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.يُتَخَطَّى: to be stepped over or crossed over
key_terms.ٱلْقِطَارُ: a line or train of camels tied one behind another

ai.seo_question: Why did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله forbid stepping over a line of camels?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله prohibited stepping over a line of camels. When asked the reason, he explained that there is a devil between one camel and the next, indicating a prohibition tied to danger, impurity, or an unseen harm associated with such conduct.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2487 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings of Allah (swt) be upon him and his family) forbade stepping over the camel line (caravan).

It was asked: "O Messenger of Allah (swt), why?"
Prophet (sw) replied: "Because there is not a single camel line except that between one camel and the next there is a devil."
